title: Myanmar Woman Among Four Sentenced To Three Years In Jail For Illegal Entry Into India From Nepal - ETV Bharat
description: Myanmar Woman Among Four Sentenced To Three Years In Jail For Illegal Entry Into India From Nepal  ETV Bharat
publisher.title: ETV Bharat
full_article:
Madhubani: A court in Jhanjharpur of Bihar's Madhubani district sentenced four persons, including a Myanmar woman, to three years in prison for illegally entering India from Nepal without valid documents.

Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate Anand Raj of Jhanjharpur Sub Divisional Civil Court on Wednesday convicted the four accused and imposed a fine of Rs 2,000 each. Failure to pay the fine will result in imprisonment of six more months.

The case dates back to October 7, 2023, when the four were apprehended at Pillar No. 246 near the Indo-Nepal border under the Laukaha police station area.

SSB Sub-Inspector Karuna Das caught Begum Tahira, a Myanmar national, while she was entering India along with her four children and three male associates. While the children were sent to the juvenile correction home in Siwan, an FIR was registered at the Laukaha police station against the Myanmar national and her three associates. The accused were remanded to judicial custody.

The arrested individuals were identified as Tahira of Aikarp district in Buthidaung region of Myanmar and Md Kadir, Md Farmud and Md Niyamat of Ghanshyampur.

title: Mastercard, MOCO launch QR payment solution for international visitors in Nepal - OnlineKhabar English News
description: Mastercard, MOCO launch QR payment solution for international visitors in Nepal  OnlineKhabar English News
publisher.title: OnlineKhabar English News
full_article:
Kathmandu, August 20

International visitors to Nepal can now use their existing Mastercard credit and debit cards to make digital payments at merchants accepting NepalPay and Fonepay QR codes nationwide.

Mastercard on Wednesday announced the launch of its Pay Local solution in Nepal in partnership with MOCO, a card-based digital wallet and unified QR payment platform.

Under the new service, international travellers can link eligible Mastercard cards to the MOCO Travel App and make payments directly through the app without having to carry cash, exchange currency or load money into prepaid accounts.

The MOCO Travel App is available on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

The service can be used at hotels, restaurants, retail outlets, local markets and other tourism-related businesses accepting NepalPay and Fonepay QR payments.

“International travellers increasingly expect the simplicity, security and convenience of their everyday payment experiences to travel with them,” said Sandun Hapugoda, country manager for Sri Lanka, Maldives, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal at Mastercard.

“With Mastercard Pay Local available on MOCO, visitors can use the cards they already know and trust across the country’s extensive QR payment ecosystem,” he said.

Mastercard said the service will also allow local businesses to serve international customers through their existing QR infrastructure, potentially helping them benefit from Nepal’s growing tourism sector.

The launch expands Mastercard’s Pay Local presence in Asia, following similar deployments in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Cambodia and Sri Lanka.

Pranaya Rajbhandari, chief executive officer of FOCUSONE Payment Solutions, said the partnership would make it easier for inbound tourists to access Nepal’s QR payment ecosystem.

“Through our travel app, inbound tourists can seamlessly access Nepal’s QR payment ecosystem, making it easier to explore the country while supporting local merchants,” Rajbhandari said.

title: Nepal’s Political Mood Is Becoming Increasingly Religiously Charged - Religion Unplugged
description: Nepal’s Political Mood Is Becoming Increasingly Religiously Charged  Religion Unplugged
publisher.title: Religion Unplugged
full_article:
(ANALYSIS) Nepal underwent an epochal political upheaval just a year ago, toppling the government in a fashion few could have imagined. An even more dramatic development followed. Voters handed a near-supermajority to the Rastriya Swatantra Party, which was founded only four years earlier. Its senior leader, Balendra Shah, became the youngest prime minister in Nepal’s history and has since been leading the country.

Madhes, the southern region bordering India from which Shah originally comes, has now witnessed one of the country’s ugliest recent communal clashes. Bullets fired by security personnel under his government killed four young people. The violence began with a relatively minor altercation of a kind that has occurred in the region before.

On July 26, clashes broke out between members of the Hindu and Muslim communities in Sunsari, a district of Koshi Province that is historically part of the Tarai-Madhes region. According to media reports, the violence began after some Muslims allegedly attacked Hindus preparing for the Bol Bam pilgrimage, during which devotees carry holy water from sacred rivers and offer it to Lord Shiva, one of Hinduism’s principal deities.

READ: India’s Religious Pluralism Has Deep Historical Roots

The conflict escalated until police opened fire, as they have repeatedly done during unrest in Madhes. Police bullets, bought with taxpayers’ money, had claimed dozens of lives during the Gen Z protests in September 2025.

In July and early August 2026, they killed four more young people : Jay Prakash Mehta, Om Prakash Mehta, Rabindra Mehta and Ganesh Yadav.

Yadav was the youngest of those killed. He was only 15 when he was shot in the neck on July 30. His death prompted Prime Minister Shah to release a short video appealing for peace and communal harmony.

The appeal was widely appreciated, but the Sunsari violence may not be the last such conflict. A more dangerous form of religious polarization appears to be developing, and the stakes could be considerably higher next time.

Evidence of this emerging political climate could also be seen in the conduct of Sher Bahadur Deuba, Nepal’s five-time former prime minister and long-serving president of the Nepali Congress, the country’s oldest political party. Deuba appeared determined to make a calculated political bet on religion.

On Aug. 16, the final day of a national gathering convened by a dissident faction of the Nepali Congress led by Deuba, the assembly adopted five resolutions. One resolution, concerning religion and culture, provoked serious discussion and ultimately caused an on-stage dispute among senior leaders. The assembly committed itself to recognizing Sanatan traditions as a defining element of Nepal’s national identity.

The resolution stated: “Nepal’s traditional religion and culture since ancient times is also our national identity. Considering the duty to protect Hindu, Buddhist, Kirat and Prakriti religions … the commitment will be made to move the nation forward with Sanatan religion as the national identity.”

The gathering formally concluded, but its final session was marred by a public dispute among senior leaders over the wording of the resolution. As leader Deepak Prasad Kuikel read the draft resolutions from the rostrum, former party vice-president Bimalendra Nidhi approached the lectern to object to the wording prepared by former spokesperson Dr. Prakash Sharan Mahat. A brief physical scuffle followed as the two leaders tugged at the document. Dr. Mahat then escorted Nidhi back to his seat.

The disagreement concerned specific language in the draft. Dr. Mahat’s version advocated recognising Sanatan traditions as part of Nepal’s national identity while guaranteeing people the freedom to practise the country’s historical faiths. Nidhi argued that the party should adhere strictly to its established position of “religious freedom” without adding any further qualification.

Deuba ultimately intervened and directed that Dr. Mahat’s original draft be read without alteration. Addressing the assembly, he said that although he personally identified as Hindu, he fully respected everyone’s freedom to practice their respective faiths.

“I am personally a Hindu,” Deuba told party cadres. “I have observed the Bratabandha sacred thread ceremony and married according to Hindu traditions. I visit Pashupatinath and offer prayers.” Speaking about state policy and constitutional questions concerning religion, he said that the ultimate authority rested with the people rather than with political leaders.

“However, what happens or does not happen in terms of religion in the country depends on the decision of the people,” Deuba said. “There must be religious freedom for everyone in the nation.”

This may appear to be an ordinary political development, but its significance should not be underestimated. Why is Deuba publicly asserting his religious identity after spending five months away from national politics and being brutally assaulted during the Gen Z protests?

One possible explanation is that Deuba is trying to recover from the political and personal humiliation he suffered after the attack on him on Sept. 9, 2025. He may also be signalling to established and aspiring politicians that he is prepared to use religion in his attempt to regain power and settle political scores.

Religion may now appear to him to be the most effective political weapon available. He seems willing to compromise one of the finest principles of the Constitution that his own party helped draft: secularism.

Prime Minister Shah’s conduct during his election campaign also raises questions. His appearances at religious sites, from Janakpur to the Pathivara temple, and an oath-taking ceremony at which 108 Batuks chanted religious verses and the timing was reportedly chosen on an astrologer’s recommendation all point in the same direction. Secularism could increasingly come under pressure as religious politics gains strength in Nepal.

My own brief encounters with established and aspiring politicians preparing to launch a new campaign reinforced this impression.

Some openly told me, “We would prioritize the agenda of Sanatan traditions and Hinduism in Nepal.”

After witnessing these developments within such a short period, I fear that religious politics could shake one of the foundations of modern Nepal: Secularism.

जुलाई आरू अगस्त २०२६ केरऽ शुरूआत म॑ चारो आरू युवा सिनी के हत्या करी देलकै : जय प्रकाश मेहता, ओम प्रकाश मेहता, रवीन्द्र मेहता आरू गणेश यादव ।

मारल गेल लोक मे यादव सबस छोट छलाह। 30 जुलाई कए जखन हुनकर गर्दन मे गोली लागल छल तखन हुनकर उम्र मात्र 15 साल छल।हुनकर मौत क बाद प्रधानमंत्री शाह शांति आ साम्प्रदायिक सौहार्द क अपील करैत एकटा छोट वीडियो जारी केलथि।

एहि अपील कए खूब सराहना भेल, मुदा सुनसरी हिंसा एहन अंतिम टकराव नहि भ सकैत अछि। धार्मिक ध्रुवीकरण केरऽ एगो आरू खतरनाक रूप विकसित होय रहलऽ नजर आबी रहलऽ छै, आरू अगला बार दांव काफी अधिक होय सकै छै ।

एहि उभरैत राजनीतिक माहौल के प्रमाण नेपाल के पांच बेर के पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री आओर देश के सबस पुरान राजनीतिक दल नेपाली कांग्रेस के दीर्घकालीन अध्यक्ष शेरबहादुर देउबा के आचरण मे सेहो देखल जा सकैत छल. देउबा धर्म पर गणितीय राजनीतिक दांव लगाबय लेल दृढ़ संकल्पित बुझाइत छलीह ।

देउबा के नेतृत्व मे नेपाली कांग्रेस के असहमत गुट द्वारा आहूत राष्ट्रीय सभा के अंतिम दिन 16 अगस्त के विधानसभा पांच प्रस्ताव पारित केलक। एकटा प्रस्ताव, जे धर्म आ संस्कृति स संबंधित छल, गंभीर चर्चा के भड़का देलक आ अंततः वरिष्ठ नेता सब के बीच मंच पर विवाद के कारण बनल। विधानसभा सनातन परंपरा कए नेपाल क राष्ट्रीय पहचान क परिभाषित तत्व क रूप मे मान्यता देबा लेल प्रतिबद्ध छल ।

प्रस्ताव मे कहल गेल छल जे, “नेपालक पारम्परिक धर्म आ संस्कृति प्राचीन काल सँ सेहो हमर राष्ट्रीय पहिचान अछि। हिन्दू, बौद्ध, किरात आ प्रकृति धर्मक रक्षा करबाक कर्तव्य पर विचार करैत ... सनातन धर्म केँ राष्ट्रीय पहिचानक रूप मे राष्ट्र केँ आगू बढेबाक प्रतिबद्धता कयल जायत।”

सभाक औपचारिक समापन भेल, मुदा एकर अंतिम सत्र प्रस्तावक शब्दावली पर वरिष्ठ नेता सभक बीच सार्वजनिक विवादक कारणेँ गड़बड़ा गेल। नेता दीपक प्रसाद कुइकेल मंच स प्रस्ताव क मसौदा पढ़ैत काल पार्टी क पूर्व उपाध्यक्ष बिमलेन्द्र निधि पूर्व प्रवक्ता डॉ. प्रकाश शरण महत द्वारा तैयार शब्दावली पर आपत्ति करबा लेल लेक्चरर लग पहुंचलाह। एकरऽ बाद कुछ देर लेली शारीरिक झगड़ा होय गेलै, कैन्हेंकि दोनों नेता न॑ दस्तावेज क॑ खींच॑ लगलै । तखन डॉ. महत निधि केँ वापस अपन सीट पर ल' गेलाह.

असहमति मसौदा मे विशिष्ट भाषा स संबंधित छल। डॉ. महत केरऽ संस्करण म॑ सनातन परंपरा क॑ नेपाल केरऽ राष्ट्रीय पहचान के हिस्सा के रूप म॑ मान्यता दै के वकालत करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै जबकि लोगऽ क॑ देश केरऽ ऐतिहासिक आस्था के पालन करै के स्वतंत्रता के गारंटी देलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । निधि के तर्क छेलै कि पार्टी क॑ अपनऽ स्थापित स्थिति “धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता” के सख्ती स॑ पालन करना चाहियऽ, बिना कोनो आरू योग्यता जोड़ले ।

देउबा अंततः हस्तक्षेप केलनि आ निर्देश देलनि जे डॉ. महत’क मूल मसौदा बिना कोनो परिवर्तन केने पढ़ल जाय. विधानसभा क॑ संबोधित करतें हुअ॑ हुनी कहलकै कि भले ही हुनी व्यक्तिगत रूप स॑ हिन्दू के रूप म॑ पहचान करै छै, लेकिन सब के अपनऽ-अपनऽ आस्था के पालन करै के आजादी के पूरा सम्मान करै छै ।

देउवा पार्टी कार्यकर्ता सब स कहलथि जे हम व्यक्तिगत रूप स हिन्दू छी। “हम ब्रतबंध पवित्र धागा समारोह के पालन केने छी आ हिन्दू परंपरा के अनुसार विवाह केने छी, पशुपतिनाथ के दर्शन करैत प्रार्थना करैत छी।” राज्य नीति आ धर्म स संबंधित संवैधानिक सवाल पर बजैत ओ कहला जे अंतिम अधिकार राजनीतिक नेता स बेसी जनता पर अछि।

देउबा कहलनि जे, ओना देश मे धर्मक दृष्टिएँ की होइत अछि वा नहि होइत अछि से जनताक निर्णय पर निर्भर करैत अछि। “राष्ट्र मे सबहक लेल धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता हेबाक चाही।”

ई साधारण राजनीतिक विकास बुझाइत होयत, मुदा एकर महत्व केँ कम नहि आंकल जाय। राष्ट्रीय राजनीति स॑ पांच महीना दूर रहला के बाद आरू जेन जेड विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान निर्मम हमला के बाद देउबा सार्वजनिक रूप स॑ अपनऽ धार्मिक पहचान के पुष्टि कियैक करी रहलऽ छै ।

एकरऽ एगो संभावित सफाई ई छै कि देउबा ९ सितम्बर २०२५ क॑ हुनका प॑ हमला के बाद जे राजनीतिक आरू व्यक्तिगत अपमान मिललऽ छेलै, ओकरा स॑ उबर॑ के कोशिश करी रहलऽ छै ।ओकरा स्थापित आरू आकांक्षी राजनेता सिनी क॑ ई भी संकेत द॑ रहलऽ हुअ॑ सकै छै कि हुनी सत्ता वापस पाबै आरू राजनीतिक स्कोर के निपटारा करै के कोशिश म॑ धर्म के इस्तेमाल करै लेली तैयार छै ।

धर्म आब हुनका उपलब्ध सबसँ प्रभावी राजनीतिक हथियार बुझना जा सकैत अछि । संविधान केरऽ एगो बेहतरीन सिद्धांत स॑ समझौता करै लेली तैयार नजर आबै छै जेकरा म॑ हुनकऽ अपनऽ पार्टी न॑ मदद करलकै: धर्मनिरपेक्षता ।

चुनाव प्रचार के दौरान प्रधानमंत्री शाह के आचरण पर सेहो सवाल उठैत अछि. जनकपुर सँ पथिवरा मंदिर धरि धार्मिक स्थल पर हुनक उपस्थिति, आ शपथ ग्रहण समारोह जाहि मे १०८ बटुक धार्मिक श्लोकक जप करैत छलाह आ ज्योतिषी केर अनुशंसा पर समय चुनबाक सूचना अछि, ई सब एकहि दिशा मे इशारा करैत अछि | नेपाल मे धार्मिक राजनीति के मजबूती बढ़ला पर धर्मनिरपेक्षता के दबाव बढ़ि सकैत अछि.

एकटा नव अभियान शुरू करबाक तैयारी मे स्थापित आ आकांक्षी राजनेता सब स हमर अपन संक्षिप्त मुठभेड़ एहि धारणा कए मजबूत केलक।

किछु गोटे हमरा खुलि क’ कहलनि, “हम सब नेपाल मे सनातन परंपरा आ हिन्दू धर्मक एजेंडा केँ प्राथमिकता देब।”

एतेक कम समय मे एहि सब घटनाक्रमक साक्षी बनलाक बाद हमरा आशंका अछि जे धार्मिक राजनीति आधुनिक नेपालक एकटा आधार धर्मनिरपेक्षता केँ हिला सकैत अछि ।

full_article:
Kathmandu, August 20

Finance Minister Dr Swarnim Wagle has said foreign aid to Nepal has been declining, with sources of grants and concessional loans becoming increasingly limited.

Speaking at a meeting of the Public Accounts Committee on Thursday, Wagle said Nepal now needs to mobilise private capital as an alternative, as traditional sources of foreign assistance continue to shrink.

According to Wagle, Nepal has relied on foreign aid and loans since its first budget to finance expenditures that could not be covered by domestic revenue. However, as the economy and the size of the national budget have grown, the share of foreign grants has declined.

“Concessional resources are narrowing. Almost all of Nepal’s major infrastructure projects were built using these loans,” Wagle said. “Traditional sources of foreign aid are now drying up. So, we are moving towards new sources of private capital.”

Wagle said the current budget has set a target of borrowing around Rs 212 billion in foreign loans, while foreign grants have been estimated at around Rs 62 billion. However, although grants of Rs 48 billion to Rs 52 billion have been projected in recent budgets, actual receipts have generally remained around Rs 10 billion to Rs 15 billion.

He said highly concessional loans, which carry interest rates of around 1% to 1.5%, with no repayment required for the first eight years and repayment periods extending up to 40 years, are gradually becoming unavailable.

Wagle said foreign assistance should be analysed separately, including aid received through NGOs and international NGOs, bilateral grants and multilateral concessional loans.

He noted that assistance through INGOs has been declining and now represents a relatively small share compared with the size of Nepal’s budget and economy.

According to Wagle, concessional loans from multilateral development partners remain an important source of development financing. However, he warned that financing conditions are becoming increasingly difficult, with rising interest rates, shorter grace periods and shorter maturity periods, while competition for limited concessional resources is also increasing.

“We are heading into an extremely challenging phase,” he said.

वागले के अनुसार बहुपक्षीय विकास भागीदारऽ स॑ रियायती ऋण विकास वित्तपोषण केरऽ एगो महत्वपूर्ण स्रोत बनलऽ छै । लेकिन हुनी चेतावनी देलकै कि वित्तपोषण के स्थिति तेजी स॑ मुश्किल होय रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ ब्याज दर बढ़ी रहलऽ छै, छूट केरऽ अवधि कम आरू परिपक्वता अवधि कम होय रहलऽ छै, जबकि सीमित रियायती संसाधन लेली प्रतिस्पर्धा भी बढ़ी रहलऽ छै ।

title: Never-Ending Peace And Love (NEPAL) - Nepali Times
description: Never-Ending Peace And Love (NEPAL)  Nepali Times

full_article:
* Maoist leader Pushpa Kamal Dahal launched an armed struggle in which 17,000 people were killed, many of them civilians accused of being class enemies. Kin of many of those killed during the conflict saw the perpetrators move around freely, yet did not seek retribution.

* Former Prime Minister K P Oli and his Home Minister Ramesh Lekhak were accused of bearing responsibility for the massacre of 19 youth outside Parliament last September. They served less than two weeks behind bars.

* Last week, former prime minister Sher Bahadur Deuba returned to Nepal to welcoming crowds after six months in self-imposed exile.

Many other known fraudsters, rapists and sexual offenders roam around openly in broad daylight because their victims have not bothered to pursue justice.

Rampant impunity in Nepal has sent the message to other potential crooks that they can literally get away with murder. Perhaps ordinary citizens do not pursue war criminals because they do not trust the judiciary or law enforcement to prosecute the case.

But the anger had been building up, and exploded in last year's protests, resulting later in the landslide victory of the RSP and the installation of Balendra Shah as prime minister. Nevertheless, there has been a remarkable lack of systematic revenge against members of the previous regime that one might have expected.

There is a Nepali saying which translates to: ‘you pretend to hit me, and I will pretend to wince in pain’. The detention of Oli and Lekhak was essentially to show voters that the PM was acting decisively against wrongdoers of the past.

CLASS WAR

Ethno-separatist or sectarian violence in Sri Lanka or parts of India have left a legacy of bad blood and a feeling of us vs them. Nepal’s Maoist insurgency, however, was a class war, after which the guerrillas became partners in coalition governments with their sworn enemies. This meant that both sides colluded to bury wartime excesses and let the transitional justice process lapse.

After the decade-long insurgency finally came to an end with the ceasefire in April 2006, Nepalis were so deeply traumatised and economically drained that public sentiment turned overwhelmingly to seek normalcy, security, and an end to daily terror. Individual vengeance was largely suppressed by a collective societal consensus to protect the fragile peace at all costs.

The abolition of monarchy itself was carried out in a civilised manner. The Constituent Assembly voted to turn Nepal into a republic on the afternoon of 28 May 2008.

During the war, atrocities were committed by abstract entities — the ‘insurgents’ or ‘state forces’ — rather than purely localised personal enemies. Social psychology shows that when harm is attributed to a collective or an ideological machine, individuals find it harder to anchor personal, targeted vengeance against a single neighbour, defusing personal accountability.

Sociologist Émile Durkheim’s idea of societal equilibrium can explain the post-war scenario. The peace deal of 2006 rescued Nepal from a state of acute anomie (normlessness ) , where wartime lawlessness had shattered societal conventions. The sudden transition to structured peace provided a predictable framework in which people eagerly clung to this new social order because human beings inherently crave the stability of social regulation over chaos.

Nepali anthropologist Dor Bahadur Bista posited that atrocities, deaths, and disappearances are frequently rationalised as a matter of fate.

The belief in reincarnation also promotes the conviction that wrongdoers will ultimately be punished in their next life, so there is no need for the victim to pursue payback in this life. Another factor could be that Nepal’s elite comprises a handful of clans interconnected by kinship or patronage.

One of the often overlooked factors could be the combination of foreign labour migration and standard state compensation served as a critical economic safety valve that neutralised post-war vengeance in Nepal

Together, these economic factors shifted the public focus away from retributive justice and effectively flattened deep-seated political grievances into structural financial relief.

Visitors, especially from the Subcontinent, remark on the relative lack of road rage on Nepal’s highways even when there is so much reckless driving. Since everyone is breaking traffic rules anyway, there is little open anger against another road user, say, making an illegal U-turn.

Still, this hypothesis cannot lead to complacency, thus allowing grievances of excluded and discriminated groups to pile up until the rage breaks through a critical threshold to explode into violent revenge.

* माओवादी नेता पुष्पकमल दाहाल सशस्त्र संघर्ष शुरू केलनि जाहि मे 17 हजार लोक मारल गेल, जाहि मे बहुतो नागरिक वर्ग दुश्मन हेबाक आरोप मे छल । संघर्ष के दौरान मारल गेल बहुतो के किन अपराधी के स्वतंत्र रूप स एम्हर-ओम्हर घुमैत देखलक, तइयो प्रतिशोध नहि लेलक।

* पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री के पी ओली आरू हुनकऽ गृहमंत्री रमेश लेखक प॑ पिछला सितंबर म॑ संसद के बाहर १९ युवा सिनी के नरसंहार के जिम्मेदारी लेन॑ के आरोप लगैलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । दू सप्ताह स कम समय सलाख क पाछु सेवा देलथि।

* विगत सप्ताह पूर्व प्रधानमन्त्री शेरबहादुर देउबा ६ महिना स्वारोपित निर्वासनके बाद भीड़के स्वागतमे नेपाल घुरल छल ।

बहुत रास अन्य ज्ञात जालसाज, बलात्कारी आ यौन अपराधी दिनक उजाला मे खुलि कए घुमैत रहैत छथि, कारण हुनकर पीड़ित लोकनि न्याय करबाक कष्ट नहि केने छथि ।

नेपाल मे बेतहाशा दंडहीनता अन्य संभावित भ्रष्टाचारी कए इ संदेश देलक अछि जे ओ अक्षरशः हत्या स बचि सकैत छथि । शायद आम नागरिक युद्ध अपराधी के पीछा नै करै छै, कैन्हेंकि ओकरा न्यायपालिका या कानून प्रवर्तन पर भरोसा नै छै कि ओकरा ई मामला के मुकदमा चलाबै के छै ।

लेकिन आक्रोश बढ़ी रहलऽ छेलै, आरू पिछला साल केरऽ विरोध प्रदर्शन म॑ विस्फोट होय गेलऽ छेलै, जेकरऽ परिणामस्वरूप बाद म॑ आरएसपी केरऽ भूस्खलन जीत आरू बलेन्द्र शाह क॑ प्रधानमंत्री के रूप म॑ स्थापित करलऽ गेलै । एकरऽ बावजूद भी पिछला शासन केरऽ सदस्यऽ के खिलाफ व्यवस्थित बदला लेबै के उल्लेखनीय कमी रहलऽ छै जेकरऽ उम्मीद करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ।

एकटा नेपाली कहावत छैक जकर अनुवाद होइत छैक : ‘अहाँ हमरा मारबाक नाटक करू, आ हम दर्द सँ मुँह बिचकबाक नाटक करब’ । ओली आरू लेखक क॑ हिरासत म॑ लेलऽ गेलऽ अनिवार्य रूप स॑ मतदाता क॑ ई देखाबै लेली छेलै कि पीएम पूर्व केरऽ गलत काम करै वाला के खिलाफ निर्णायक रूप स॑ काम करी रहलऽ छै ।

वर्ग युद्ध

श्रीलंका या भारत केरऽ कुछ हिस्सा म॑ नृवंश-अलगाववादी या साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा न॑ खराब खून के विरासत आरू हम्मं॑ बनाम ओकरा के भावना छोड़ी देल॑ छै । नेपाल केरऽ माओवादी विद्रोह, लेकिन वर्गयुद्ध छेलै, जेकरा बाद गुरिल्ला अपनऽ शपथ ग्रहण करलऽ दुश्मनऽ के साथ गठबंधन सरकारऽ के भागीदार बनी गेलै । एकरऽ मतलब छेलै कि दोनों पक्ष न॑ मिल क॑ युद्धकालीन अति के दफनाबै के काम करलकै आरू संक्रमणकालीन न्याय प्रक्रिया क॑ खतम होय गेलै ।

अप्रैल २००६ म॑ युद्धविराम के साथ आखिरकार दशक भर स॑ चलै वाला विद्रोह के समापन के बाद नेपाली लोगऽ क॑ एतना गहरा आघात आरू आर्थिक रूप स॑ पानी केरऽ निकासी होय गेलै कि जनभावना भारी संख्या म॑ सामान्यता, सुरक्षा आरू दैनिक आतंक के अंत के कोशिश म॑ बदली गेलै । व्यक्तिगत प्रतिशोध क॑ बहुत हद तक एक सामूहिक सामाजिक सहमति स॑ दबा देलऽ गेलै ताकि हर हालत म॑ नाजुक शांति के रक्षा करलऽ जाय सक॑ ।

राजतंत्रक उन्मूलन स्वयं सभ्य ढंगसँ भेल । संविधानसभा 28 मई 2008 के दुपहर मे नेपाल के गणतंत्र बनेबाक लेल मतदान केलक ।

युद्ध के दौरान अत्याचार विशुद्ध रूप स॑ स्थानीयकृत व्यक्तिगत दुश्मनऽ के बजाय अमूर्त इकाई — ‘विद्रोही’ या ‘राज्य बल’ — द्वारा करलऽ जाय छेलै । सामाजिक मनोविज्ञान सें पता चलै छै कि जब॑ कोनो सामूहिक या वैचारिक मशीन के नुकसान पहुँचैलऽ जाय छै त॑ व्यक्ति क॑ एक ही पड़ोसी के खिलाफ व्यक्तिगत, लक्षित प्रतिशोध के लंगर डालना मुश्किल होय जाय छै, जेकरा स॑ व्यक्तिगत जवाबदेही क॑ निष्क्रिय होय जाय छै ।

समाजशास्त्री एमिल डुर्केइम केरऽ सामाजिक संतुलन के विचार युद्ध के बाद के परिदृश्य के व्याख्या करी सकै छै । 2006 के शांति समझौता नेपाल के तीव्र अनोमी (normlessness ) के अवस्था स बचा लेलक , जतय युद्धकालीन अराजकता सामाजिक रूढ़ि के चकनाचूर क देने छल । संरचित शांति में अचानक संक्रमण एकटा पूर्वानुमानित रूपरेखा प्रदान केलक जाहि में लोक बेसब्री सं एहि नव सामाजिक व्यवस्था सं चिपकल छल, कारण मनुष्य अराजकता पर सामाजिक नियमन के स्थिरता के लेल स्वाभाविक रूप सं तरसैत अछि.

नेपाली मानवशास्त्री डोर बहादुर बिष्ट अत्याचार, मृत्यु, आ लापता होयब के अक्सर भाग्य के बात के रूप में तर्कसंगत बनाओल जाइत अछि ।

पुनर्जन्म केरऽ विश्वास ई विश्वास क॑ भी बढ़ावा दै छै कि गलती करै वाला क॑ अंततः ओकरऽ अगला जीवन म॑ सजा मिलतै, ई लेली पीड़ित क॑ ई जीवन म॑ पेबैक के पीछा करै के कोय जरूरत नै छै । एकटा आओर कारक ई भ’ सकैत अछि जे नेपालक अभिजात वर्ग मे रिश्तेदारी वा संरक्षण सँ एक दोसरा सँ जुड़ल मुट्ठी भरि कुल शामिल अछि |

अक्सर अनदेखी करलऽ जाय वाला कारकऽ म॑ स॑ एगो विदेशी मजदूर पलायन आरू मानक राज्य मुआवजा के संयोजन भी होय सकै छै जे एक महत्वपूर्ण आर्थिक सुरक्षा वाल्व के रूप म॑ काम करलकै जे नेपाल म॑ युद्ध के बाद के प्रतिशोध क॑ बेअसर करी देलकै

ई आर्थिक कारक सब मिल क॑ जनता के ध्यान प्रतिशोधात्मक न्याय स॑ दूर करी देलकै आरू प्रभावी ढंग स॑ गहराई स॑ जड़लऽ राजनीतिक शिकायत क॑ संरचनात्मक वित्तीय राहत म॑ समतल करी देलकै ।

खास क’ उपमहाद्वीप स आबय वाला आगंतुक नेपाल के राजमार्ग पर सड़क पर आक्रोश के अपेक्षाकृत कमी पर टिप्पणी करैत छथि, जखन कि एतेक लापरवाह गाड़ी चलाबय के समय सेहो अछि. चूँकि सब कियो ओनाहु ट्रैफिक नियम तोड़ि रहल अछि, तेँ दोसर सड़क पर चलय बला, कहियो गैरकानूनी यू-टर्न करय पर खुला आक्रोश कम अछि.

तइयो ई परिकल्पना आत्मसंतोष के तरफ नै ल जा सकै छै, जेकरा स॑ बहिष्कृत आरू भेदभाव वाला समूहऽ के शिकायत तब तलक ढेर होय जाय छै जब॑ तलक कि क्रोध एगो महत्वपूर्ण दहलीज क॑ तोड़ी क॑ हिंसक बदला म॑ विस्फोट नै करी दै छै ।

title: Nepal Speaker orders PM Balendra Shah to face House on Aug 26 after months of absence - connectedtoindia.com
description: Nepal Speaker orders PM Balendra Shah to face House on Aug 26 after months of absence  connectedtoindia.com

full_article:
Nepal Speaker Dol Prasad Aryal has directed Prime Minister Balendra Shah to appear before the House of Representatives on August 26 and respond directly to questions from lawmakers.

Nepal’s Prime Minister Balendra Shah. Photo: Facebook/@balenOfficial



The directive follows months of pressure from opposition parties over Shah’s repeated absence from Parliament.

According to the details provided, the prime minister attended only five of the first 39 House sittings after taking office.

Aryal issued the ruling following repeated demands from opposition lawmakers for Shah to appear before the House.

“I rule that the right honourable prime minister attend the meeting of the House of Representatives and answer questions from honourable members,” Aryal said.

The decision brings an end to a 77-day opposition protest centred on Shah’s failure to clarify remarks he made regarding the Nepal-India border.

Opposition demanded Shah’s presence

Opposition parties had been pressing Shah to attend Parliament since May, accusing the prime minister of avoiding direct parliamentary scrutiny.

Lawmakers also questioned his absence during discussions on communal unrest in Sunsari, where four people were killed in the last week of July.

Nepali Congress whip Nischal Rai had warned that opposition parties would continue their protest unless Shah appeared before the House.

“Has the PM escaped questions and tried to weaken democracy?” Rai asked.

“If the prime minister remains absent, the protest will continue,” he added.

Under House rules, the first hour of one sitting during the first week of every month is reserved for lawmakers to directly question the prime minister.

Border remarks triggered political confrontation

Shah’s previous appearance in the House on May 31 became the centre of a separate political dispute after he commented on the Nepal-India border issue.

Responding to a question concerning the border dispute, Shah said: “After becoming PM, I came to know that not only has India encroached on Nepal’s land, but Nepal has also encroached on India’s land.”

He added: “Both sides need to sit down and look into the matter.”

The remarks triggered criticism from opposition parties, which demanded evidence, the withdrawal of the statement and an apology.

Opposition lawmakers argued that Shah’s comments could weaken Nepal’s position on the disputed areas of Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura.

Opposition rejects clarification

The controversy continued even after Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal explained Shah’s remarks in Parliament.

Khanal said the prime minister had been referring to cross-border occupation and encroachment in no-man’s-land areas rather than making a formal Nepalese territorial claim over Indian territory.

However, Shram Sanskriti Party lawmaker Harka Rai rejected the clarification and insisted that Shah himself should address the issue.

“The person who made the mistake must come and rectify it,” Rai said.

With the Speaker now directing Shah to attend the August 26 sitting, the prime minister is expected to face lawmakers directly over the issues that have fuelled the prolonged parliamentary confrontation.

नेपालक सभापति डोलप्रसाद अर्यल प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाहकेँ २६ अगस्तमे प्रतिनिधि सभामे हाजिर भऽ विधायकसभक प्रश्नक सोझे उत्तर देबाक निर्देश देलनि अछि ।

नेपालक प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाह। फोटो: फेसबुक/@balenOfficial



ई निर्देश शाह के बार-बार संसद सं अनुपस्थिति के ल क विपक्षी दल के महीना भर के दबाव के बाद आयल अछि.

देल गेल विवरण क अनुसार प्रधानमंत्री पदभार ग्रहण क बाद सदन क पहिल 39 बैसार मे स मात्र पांचटा बैसार मे भाग लेलथि।

विपक्षी विधायक सब के बेर-बेर शाह के सदन में हाजिर होबय के मांग के बाद अर्यल ई फैसला जारी केलनि।

अर्यल कहलनि जे, हमर फैसला अछि जे सही माननीय प्रधानमंत्री प्रतिनिधि सभा के बैसार मे उपस्थित होथि आ माननीय सदस्य के सवाल के जवाब देथि।

ई फैसला स॑ शाह केरऽ नेपाल-भारत सीमा के संबंध म॑ करलऽ गेलऽ टिप्पणी क॑ स्पष्ट नै करला प॑ केन्द्रित ७७ दिन स॑ चलै वाला विपक्षी विरोध प्रदर्शन के अंत होय गेलऽ छै ।

विपक्ष शाह के मौजूदगी के मांग केलक

विपक्षी दल मई स शाह पर संसद मे उपस्थित हेबाक दबाव बना रहल छल, प्रधानमंत्री पर सीधा संसदीय जांच स बचबाक आरोप लगा रहल छल।

जुलाई केरऽ आखिरी सप्ताह म॑ सुनसरी म॑ सांप्रदायिक अशांति प॑ चर्चा के दौरान विधायक न॑ हुनकऽ अनुपस्थिति प॑ भी सवाल उठैलकै ।

नेपाली कांग्रेसक सचेतक निश्चल राय शाह सदन मे हाजिर नहि हेताह ता धरि विपक्षी दल अपन विरोध जारी रखबाक चेतावनी देने छलाह ।

“की पीएम सवाल स बचल छथि आ लोकतंत्र कए कमजोर करबाक प्रयास केलथि अछि?” राय पुछलकै।

ओ आगू कहलनि जे, यदि प्रधानमंत्री अनुपस्थित रहताह त विरोध जारी रहत।

सदन के नियम के तहत हर महीना के पहिल सप्ताह के दौरान एक बैसार के पहिल घंटा विधायक के लेल आरक्षित अछि जे ओ सीधा प्रधानमंत्री सं पूछताछ क सकय.

सीमा पर टिप्पणी स राजनीतिक टकराव शुरू भ गेल

नेपाल-भारत सीमा मुद्दा पर टिप्पणी केलाक बाद शाह के पहिने 31 मई के सदन मे उपस्थिति अलग राजनीतिक विवाद के केंद्र बनि गेल छल.

सीमा विवाद स जुड़ल एकटा सवाल क जवाब दैत शाह कहला जे पीएम बनला क बाद हमरा इ पता चलल जे भारत नेपाल क जमीन पर त अतिक्रमण केलक अछि, नेपाल भारत क जमीन पर सेहो अतिक्रमण केलक अछि।”

ओ आगू कहलनि जे, दुनू पक्ष के बैस क मामला के देखय के जरूरत अछि।

ई टिप्पणी के बाद विपक्षी दल के आलोचना शुरू होय गेलै, जेकरा म॑ सबूत, बयान वापस लेबै आरू माफी माँगै के मांग करलऽ गेलै ।

विपक्षी विधायकक तर्क छल जे शाहक एहि टिप्पणी सँ कालापानी, लिपुलेख आ लिम्पियाधुरा विवादित क्षेत्र पर नेपालक स्थिति कमजोर भ’ सकैत अछि ।

विपक्ष स्पष्टीकरण के खारिज क देलक

संसद मे विदेश मंत्री शिशिर खनाल शाह के एहि टिप्पणी के व्याख्या केलाक बाद सेहो विवाद जारी रहल.

title: Hotel Association Nepal Demands Removal of 10% Share Rule for Casinos - Ratopati
description: Hotel Association Nepal Demands Removal of 10% Share Rule for Casinos  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Hotel Association Nepal (HAN) has demanded the removal of the proposed provision that makes it mandatory for hotels to have a 10 percent share in star hotels operating casinos. Speaking in the discussion on the Tourism Bill, 2081, in the meeting of the House of Representatives' International Relations and Tourism Committee on Thursday, HAN President Binayak Shah made this demand.

Shah argued that while the provision allows casinos to operate in four-star and five-star hotels, making a 10 percent share of the concerned hotel mandatory is not appropriate. He stated that making hotels mandatory partners in casino operations would lead to a situation where hotels would have to bear the legal and financial liabilities arising after the casino closes down.

Complaining that hoteliers are still dealing with casino-related legal cases today, he said that hotels should be allowed to take shares in casinos only if they wish to invest. Expressing objection to the proposed provision, President Shah said, "This bill states that casinos can be operated in four-star and five-star hotels and that the hotel must have a 10 percent share in it. Even today, hotels are suffering the consequences and dealing with legal cases after casinos have closed down and fled."

Emphasizing the need for a voluntary arrangement, he added, "When we discussed many times, it was decided that the hotel's share in casinos should not be mandatory, it should be voluntary. However, since the draft again includes a mandatory 10 percent share, it cannot be accepted."

He expressed dissatisfaction that while the bill's clause 40 allows foreign joint investment in casinos, it does not do so in the hotel business sector. Mentioning that there are currently more than 40 international brand hotels in Nepal, he expressed the view that foreign joint investment should be encouraged in the hotel sector as well to attract technology and foreign investment.

In addition, just as casinos are allowed to spend 2 percent of their net income on Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), he demanded that hotels also be given a provision to spend a certain percentage of their net income on CSR.

The proposed bill also includes a provision that one must have climbed at least one peak higher than seven thousand meters to climb Mount Everest.

title: Gagan Thapa: Nepal Cannot Afford New Political Adventures - Ratopati
description: Gagan Thapa: Nepal Cannot Afford New Political Adventures  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article: Kathmandu. Nepali Congress President Gagan Thapa has stated that Nepal cannot afford any new political 'adventure' at present. Speaking at the book launch of 'Dolkha's Loknayaks' in Kathmandu on Thursday, he said that Nepal does not need political 'adventure' anymore. Thapa opined that the Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) has received a mandate from the public to run the government for five years and should be given the opportunity to work for five years. He also informed that Congress is preparing to run the government after five years. Stating that they will learn from the past and correct themselves, he advised the new political forces not to repeat the mistakes and crises faced by the old parties. He urged the government to be free from the illusion that numbers alone are important, mentioning that in the past, Congress and UML also ignored public dissatisfaction and considered their majority and mandate sufficient, the consequences of which are now being faced. He stated that a political force becomes weak after losing continuous public support and moral leadership despite having a two-thirds majority, and that moral leadership is important in a democracy. He said that the government must maintain the trust of all citizens, whether they voted for it or not. Speaking about learning from the past, Thapa said, 'We only looked upwards, we only looked at the power and prestige we had, that cannot take us to the right place. This is what we learned yesterday, we want to correct ourselves from that learning.' Giving advice to the new parties, he added, 'Why should new friends go through what we have gone through? I keep saying, at least do not undertake any new political adventure in Nepal, Nepal cannot bear it anymore.' Thapa also raised questions about the dignity of the parliament and the responsibility of the members of parliament. He said that MPs should be serious about every word they speak and every decision they make after reaching parliament, accusing the current MPs of speaking whatever they want. Speaking about the dignity of the parliament, he said, 'If every victorious MP feels like they are wearing a garland, does it mean I can say whatever I want? Can I blow whatever I want? Is this parliament? Does parliament have no dignity? Does parliament have no respect?' Emphasizing the need for utmost caution in parliament, Thapa said that everyone who gets responsibility in parliament, government, court, and constitutional bodies must exercise their rights not only legally but also validly and justifiably from the perspective of public sentiment. He mentioned that some things, while legal, go against public sentiment, and clarified that no one has the liberty to go against the feelings of the public.

हम कहैत रहैत छी, कम स कम नेपाल मे कोनो नव राजनीतिक साहसिक काज नहि करू, नेपाल आब सहन नहि क सकैत अछि।' थापा संसदके गरिमा आ संसद सदस्यके जिम्मेवारीके विषयमे सेहो प्रश्न उठौलनि । ओ कहलनि जे, सांसद के संसद पहुंचला के बाद अपन हर शब्द आ हर फैसला पर गंभीर रहबाक चाही, वर्तमान सांसद पर आरोप लगबैत जे ओ जे चाहथि से बजैत छथि। संसद के गरिमा के बात करैत ओ कहलनि जे, जौं हर विजयी सांसद के लागैत अछि जे ओ माला पहिरने छथि त एकर मतलब की हम जे चाहब से कहि सकैत छी? की हम जे चाहब से उड़ा सकैत छी? ई संसद अछि की ? संसद के कोनो मर्यादा नै छै की नै? संसद के कोनो सम्मान नै छै?' संसद मे अत्यंत सावधानी बरतबाक आवश्यकता पर जोर दैत थापा संसद, सरकार, न्यायालय, आ संवैधानिक निकाय मे जे कियो जिम्मेवारी पाबैत अछि ओकरा कानूनी रूपे नहि अपितु जनभावनाक दृष्टिकोण सँ वैध आ जायज तरीका सँ अपन अधिकारक प्रयोग करय पड़त से बतौलनि । हुनी ई बात के जिक्र करलकै कि कुछ बात कानूनी होय के बावजूद जनभावना के खिलाफ छै, आरू स्पष्ट करलकै कि जनता के भावना के खिलाफ जाय के आजादी ककरो नै छै ।
